mapper.select: SELECT * FROM test_plans ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM test_plans WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM test_plans WHERE app_id = #{appId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM test_plans WHERE plan_type = #{planType} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM test_plans WHERE enabled = TRUE AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY next_run_time ASC
SELECT * FROM test_plans WHERE enabled = TRUE AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND next_run_time IS NOT NULL AND next_run_time <= #{currentTime} ORDER BY next_run_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_plans (id, name, description, cron_expression, timezone, device_id, device_ids, app_id, scenario_id, scenario_ids, scenario_config, plan_type, case_ids, enabled, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{cronExpression}, #{timezone}, #{deviceId}, #{deviceIds, typeHandler=com.mobile.standalone.mapper.typehandler.JsonListTypeHandler}, #{appId}, #{scenarioId}, #{scenarioIds, typeHandler=com.mobile.standalone.mapper.typehandler.JsonListTypeHandler}, #{scenarioConfig}, #{planType}, #{caseIds, typeHandler=com.mobile.standalone.mapper.typehandler.JsonListTypeHandler}, #{enabled}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE test_plans SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, cron_expression = #{cronExpression}, timezone = #{timezone}, device_id = #{deviceId}, device_ids = #{deviceIds, typeHandler=com.mobile.standalone.mapper.typehandler.JsonListTypeHandler}, app_id = #{appId}, scenario_id = #{scenarioId}, scenario_ids = #{scenarioIds, typeHandler=com.mobile.standalone.mapper.typehandler.JsonListTypeHandler}, scenario_config = #{scenarioConfig}, plan_type = #{planType}, case_ids = #{caseIds, typeHandler=com.mobile.standalone.mapper.typehandler.JsonListTypeHandler}, enabled = #{enabled}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE test_plans SET last_run_time = #{lastRunTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE test_plans SET next_run_time = #{nextRunTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE test_plans SET run_count = run_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
